source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_34/test_4.csv"  # ['batsman', 'total_runs']

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

source0_renamed = source0.rename(columns={'batsman_runs': 'batsman_runs_x'})
source3_renamed = source3.rename(columns={'batsman_runs': 'batsman_runs_y'})

source4_renamed = source4.rename(columns={'total_runs': 'total_runs_y'})

df_batsman_runs = pd.merge(source0_renamed, source3_renamed, on='batsman', how='inner')

# Step 3: Merge source1 and source4 on 'batsman' to get total_runs_x and total_runs_y
df_total_runs = pd.merge(source1_renamed, source4_renamed, on='batsman', how='inner')

df = pd.merge(df_batsman_runs, df_total_runs, on='batsman', how='inner')

int_cols = ['total_runs_x', 'batsman_runs_x', 'batsman_runs_y', 'no of balls', 'batsman_runs', 'total_runs_y']
for col in int_cols:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

if 'strike' in df.columns:
    df['strike'] = df['strike'].fillna(0.0).astype(float)

    'strike': 'mean',
    'total_runs_y': 'sum'
}

df = df.sort_values('batsman').reset_index(drop=True)
